description: This script automates the process of locating a C preprocessor (cpp) executable within a specified directory, patches its specs file to modify linking and include paths, and handles different compiler versions to ensure compatibility. It is part of a build/setup process for a cross-compilation toolchain in an OpenWRT environment.

methods.name: patch_specs
methods.description: Modifies the specs file for the specified toolchain directory's cpp executable to adjust library paths and include directives, facilitating cross-compilation.
